plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it
plain-words.quote_longest: (1) There is created an authority, which is a public body corporate and politic, to be known as the “Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation.” The members of the board shall consist of 6 members nominated by the governor, and with the advice and consent of the senate appointed

fair-exchange.quote_gets: The chief executive officer shall receive such compensation as may be determined by the board.
